title: Italian-Style Pickle Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with tangy pickles, perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and pepper.
Add finely chopped pickle and mix well.
Gradually add water to form a thick batter.
Heat a non-stick pan with 1-2 cm of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry until the fritters are golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
Sprinkle with a pinch of delight to taste.
